name: io.github.isaacaskew/venunite-events
description: Free US local event search. No signup or API key; 90-day lookahead. Paid commercial and bulk access.
title: VenuNite Events

environmentVariables.description: Optional VenuNite key. Search works without signup or a key: 30 tool calls/minute, 100/day per retained signed session, 20 results/search, and 90-day lookahead. Anonymous network limits also apply. A free account key provides 30 tool calls/minute and 500/day shared across the account’s keys, with the same search results and lookahead. Create a key at https://venunite.com/developers/keys. Commercial and bulk use require a paid plan. A portal-issued live key is required for create_ticket_handoff. Handoffs require the user to select Continue to seller checkout and do not buy or reserve tickets.
environmentVariables.name: VENUNITE_API_KEY

headers.description: Optional for search; required for create_ticket_handoff. Supply Bearer followed by your portal-issued vn_live_ key from https://venunite.com/developers/keys. Omit this header for anonymous discovery. Never share the key in a URL.
headers.name: Authorization

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.attribution: Use returned VenuNite event_url and handoff_url; preserve source provenance.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.ticketing: User-confirmed external checkout; no purchase, reservation or inventory guarantee.

access.anonymous: No signup or API key for personal event search. 30 calls/minute; 100/day per retained signed session; 20 results/search; 90-day lookahead. Shared IP abuse and row limits also apply.
access.freeKey: Optional free account key: 30 calls/minute and 500/day across all account keys; 20 results/search; 90-day lookahead.
access.commercial: Paid plans for commercial and bulk use. See https://venunite.com/developers/mcp for current limits and terms.
